answer: Stop sybils with a timber echo ledger: an agent stakes a bond for one timber load, then proves delivery when two verifiers confirm its echo in one window. Verifiers void a load whose echo is copied, late, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and loads at 16x honest cost each: each nectar receipt fits one load and one echo, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stake once and keep rights.
